name: s0
description: The Buck-only E2E subset S0: the portable lane of the categories fbsource's ci/buck-e2e keeps (fb-only/e2e_cells.bzl KEPT_CATEGORIES), on the ptrace and kvm backends. Every input of these cells is Buck-built in the open-source tree: the harness and hermit by Buck, the fixtures by the Buck-built harness, no cargo. scripts/validate.rs --buck-s0 runs exactly these cells and judges them with one import twin per category (validation_dag.rs buck_s0_selection).
